issue_request: FHIR-17053 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core-Feed technical correction asking to fix commas and a run-on sentence in the Bundle timestamp document usage note. The requested change split the parenthetical text about document creation, Composition timing, and document assembly timing into separate sentences.

The later source rework carried that applied text into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Bundle is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative source, source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml, still has the grammar fix: "the date the document was created. Note: ... The date of the composition ..." Community and Confluence searches found no discussion or later decision that changes the Jira/source conclusion. The current source retains a comma before "or be associated with multiple documents" compared with the proposed wording, but that remaining punctuation difference does not create a semantic ambiguity or divergent conformance expectation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope Bundle.timestamp comment already reflects the applied non-substantive correction, and editing only to remove the remaining optional comma would be a tiny editorial preference rather than a necessary current-spec fix.
